title: Reports on and Penalties for Employers who Make CPF Contributions to "Phantom Workers"
what_it_is: Reports on and Penalties for Employers who Make CPF Contributions to "Phantom Workers"

sections.label: Phantom worker quota inflation reports
sections.summary: MOM received about 660 yearly reports from 2015 to 2021 on firms inflating foreign worker quotas via phantom workers, issuing penalties and other enforcement actions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: From 2015 to 2021, MOM received about 660 reports per year on firms inflating their foreign worker quota by making CPF contributions to locals who are not working for the firm, otherwise known as "phantom workers".

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Administrative financial penalties were issued against 11 employers per year over this period.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The median penalty was $15,000 and the penalties ranged from $1,250 to $200,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Other enforcement actions taken included issuing cautions, directions to rectify breaches and debarment from hiring migrant workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM investigates all reports received and generates investigation leads through data analytics.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We will continue to monitor the effectiveness of our measures and review them where necessary.

sections.label: MOM data-mining evidence gathering
sections.summary: MOM has used data-mining capabilities in recent years to strengthen evidence gathering and take action against errant employers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: In recent years, MOM has used data-mining capabilities to strengthen evidence gathering and enable MOM to take action against errant employers.
